name: cache
description: Installs and configures Memcached and Redis, enables both services, creates the Redis log directory, and configures Redis on port 6379.

name: fastapi-tutorial
description: Deploys the FastAPI tutorial application from GitHub, installs Python and PostgreSQL dependencies, creates a virtual environment and PostgreSQL database/user, and runs the application with systemd on port 8000.

name: nginx-multisite
description: Configures Nginx for three SSL-enabled virtual hosts with static content, security headers, rate limiting, gzip, HTTP-to-HTTPS redirects, and service management.
